legacyNarrowing: Existing integer/decimal accessors preserve wrong-kind checks and must refuse out-of-range or inexact values rather than round.
bigIntegerAccess: Accept Kind.Integer and recognized legacy decimal-backed integer values; reject ordinary decimal kind values without integer classification.
exactDecimalAccess: Accept Kind.Decimal, including existing integer-tagged decimal representations; preserve wrong-kind refusal for Kind.Integer.
annotationStrings: Ordinary schema-name annotation overloads do not authenticate authority, provenance or assessment.
quotaBoundary: Already-created BigInteger input does not bound caller allocation; admission, parsing and arithmetic must enforce session limits separately.
